transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. To be honest, it's a bit hard for me to talk about, but I feel like once I start eating at night after work, I just can’t stop or control how much I’m eating. It has gotten to the point where I feel completely out of control once I get home in the evenings.
After these episodes of overeating, do you ever feel the need to take drastic measures to prevent weight gain, such as self-induced vomiting, excessive exercising, or using laxatives?

No, I don't do anything like vomiting, taking laxatives, or exercising to make up for it. Instead, I usually just sit there feeling disgusted and ashamed, scrolling through my phone or work emails to distract myself. In fact, far from exercising, I’ve actually been avoiding my usual yoga group lately because of how I feel.
How many days per week, on average, would you say these episodes of feeling out of control with your eating occur?

They have been happening at least a couple of times every week, usually on the nights when I get home late from the office. This has been going on for about three months now, ever since my work project really ramped up.
During these episodes, do you find yourself eating much more rapidly than normal or eating until you feel uncomfortably full?

Yes, I do both. I eat incredibly fast, barely chewing or tasting the food, and sometimes I have to remind myself to slow down so I don't choke. I also keep going until my stomach is so tight and stretched that it's uncomfortable to stand up, but I'll still force down a few more bites even though I feel sick.
